title: 10 Best Free AI Video Editing Tools in 2026
content: AI video editing is changing the way creators make videos in 2026. Modern AI tools can help with video editing, captions, background removal, audio enhancement and many other creative tasks. These tools are especially useful for YouTube creators, TikTok creators and beginners who want to create professional content faster. Before using any tool, check its current free plan, features and usage limits because these can change.
